As someone that doesn't have an espresso machine, I can offer a tip for those who also don't/can't afford the good handheld whisks cause they're pretty expensive.

I've got a cheap little milk kettle solely for heating the milk (it can also foam at the same time, but as was said in the video, you have no control over it) and then a tall skinny manual plunger (basically a French press, just a tall skinny one) for foaming.

It takes a bit of practice learning how much and how high to foam it for it to have the right amount, but I've gotten both beautiful and delicious coffee using this method!

I hope this helps someone 💖 in this economy, i don't want people to think they need to spend stupid amounts of money to make good coffee. You absolutely don't have to, you can make really good coffee with pretty basic tools
